note: National helplines. See sources.json for publisher, URL and verification date per entry.

entries.name: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
entries.description: India's single, unified emergency number for police, fire and ambulance response, run by the Ministry of Home Affairs.

entries.name: National Cybercrime Reporting Helpline
entries.description: Call immediately to report financial cyber fraud (UPI, banking, card) so the amount can potentially be frozen before it moves further. Also used for other cybercrime reports.

entries.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (NCRP)
entries.description: File a detailed cybercrime complaint online, with a special focus on crimes against women and children.

entries.name: Women Helpline
entries.description: Government of India helpline for women affected by violence or in distress, and for information on women-focused schemes, under Mission Shakti.

entries.name: Child Helpline (CHILDLINE)
entries.description: For any child in need of care and protection, or anyone reporting concern for a child's safety.

entries.name: Tele MANAS — Mental Health Helpline
entries.description: Free, confidential tele-counselling and mental health support from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

entries.name: National Legal Aid Helpline (NALSA)
entries.description: Free legal aid and advice from the National Legal Services Authority, including assistance for women.
entries.availability: Business hours (varies by state legal services authority)

entries.name: Rail Madad
entries.description: Indian Railways' integrated helpline for security concerns, medical emergencies and other assistance while travelling by train.

entries.name: National Highway Helpline
entries.description: Toll-free NHAI helpline for emergencies and assistance on national highways.

entries.name: Elderline — Senior Citizens Helpline
entries.description: National helpline offering care, guidance and assistance for senior citizens.

entries.name: National Consumer Helpline
entries.description: Assistance and complaint registration for consumer grievances, run by the Department of Consumer Affairs.

entries.name: SHe-Box — Workplace Harassment Portal
entries.description: File a sexual harassment complaint under the POSH Act, 2013, routed to the relevant Internal or Local Committee.

entries.name: National Commission for Women (NCW)
entries.description: Statutory body for women's rights; register a complaint online for redress and follow-up.

entries.name: Sanchar Saathi
entries.description: Block or trace a lost or stolen mobile phone, and check which SIM connections are registered in your name.

entries.name: National Disaster Management Authority — Control Room
entries.description: National disaster helpline for large-scale emergencies and disaster response coordination.
entries.availability: 24x7 during activation; otherwise check the NDMA site

entries.name: Tourist Helpline
entries.description: Ministry of Tourism's 24x7 multilingual tourist helpline.
